name: The Spark
fieldReading: Go before you're ready. Readiness follows.
bio: The one who moves first — a small, brave ignition in the dark. Nothing happens until they begin.
sceneStory: At the center of an enormous empty stage, its far edges lost in black, a lean figure crouches on one knee and drags a match down a plank, throwing a small fan of sparks. From the lit match-head a thin stem of fire climbs and branches overhead into a glowing tree of flame, its light pushing the dark back to reveal rows of empty seats.
assignment: Be the first one moving, before it feels reasonable. The moment was only ever waiting for you.
